def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in range(1,9):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    h=h2=I.shape[0]; Q={'TL':O[:h,:h],'TR':O[:h,h:],'BL':O[h:,:h],'BR':O[h:,h:]}
    rel={}
    for qn,q in Q.items():
        if np.array_equal(q,I): continue
        if np.array_equal(q,I[::-1]): rel[qn]='ud'; continue
        if np.array_equal(q,I[:,::-1]): rel[qn]='lr'; continue
        if np.array_equal(q,I[::-1,::-1]): rel[qn]='rot180'; continue
        if np.array_equal(q,I.T): rel[qn]='T'; continue
        # anti-diagonal reflection variants
        if np.array_equal(q,np.fliplr(I.T)): rel[qn]='antiT_lr'; continue
        if np.array_equal(q,np.flipud(I.T)): rel[qn]='antiT_ud'; continue
        if np.array_equal(q,I.T[:,::-1]): rel[qn]='aT_lr'; continue
        rel[qn]='OTHER'
    print(n,rel)

import numpy as np, os,re,json

import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 8 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 8 output'])
S=I[:4,:4]; BR=O[4:,4:]
ia=np.arange(BR.shape[0]).reshape(4,-1); ib=np.arange(BR.shape[1]).reshape(-1,1)
found=None
for a in range(4):
    for b in range(4):
        ra=(ia*a+b)%4
        for c in range(4):
            for d in range(4):
                cb=(ib*c+d)%4
                T=S[np.ix_(ra.ravel(),cb.ravel())].reshape(BR.shape)
                if np.array_equal(T,BR): found=(a,b,c,d); break
            if found: break
        if found: break
    if found: break
print('affine map:',found)

import numpy as np, itertools, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    nz=(I!=0); rs,cs=np.where(nz)
    S=I[rs.min():rs.max()+1, cs.min():cs.max()+1]; h,w=S.shape

    qu={'tl':O[:N,:N],'tr':O[:N,N:],'bl':O[N:,:N],'br':O[N:,N:]}
    trs=[]
    for k in range(4):

        print(p,n,S.shape,'hits:',hits,'quadshape',q.shape)
